units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 750:17">Yalk. Num. 750</cite> (Korah, beg.) <he>זמן הג׳</he> (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:13">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite> <he>זמן גיזה</he>) the season of shearing.
<cite ref="Chullin 135a:20">Ḥull. 135ᵃ</cite> <he>מחוסר ג׳ וכ׳</he> wants shearing, redemption &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:5">Gen. R. s. 74</cite>; s. 85; Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII <he>כל מקום שנ׳ ג׳ וכ׳</he> wherever shearing is mentioned in biblical accounts, it marks (an important epoch).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 3:1:12">Y. Orl. III, 63ᵃ</cite> top (in Chald. diction) what profit is it to him <he>גזים גזיזית</he> (read … <he>זוֹת</he>) to cut it into shreds?
